_meta.purpose: Engine settings NOT found in knowledge/*.json. Every entry carries _source and _provisional. Provisional entries are listed in docs/OPEN_ITEMS.md. knowledge/ files stay untouched (owner approval required).

adherence_threshold_pct._source: placeholder; OPEN_ITEMS 'Adherence threshold that blocks calorie changes'

data_quality._source: BUILD_SPEC §7.5 (min weigh-ins/week is read from nutrition tracking.weigh_ins_per_week[0])

confidence._source: placeholder scoring for BUILD_SPEC §7.5 'flags lower proposal confidence'

cold_start._source: owner request 2026-10-03 (mid-program onboarding). Nutrition gate reads tracking.min_weeks_before_trend. 'applies_to' pending owner confirmation, see OPEN_ITEMS

training._source: ch7 says 'smaller set additions' in a cut and ch3 says MRV hit on 'multiple muscles'; no numbers given. RIR between week 1 and final week is not tabulated

phase_transition._source: placeholder signals for 'past recommended cut length + fatigue' (BUILD_SPEC §11)

cardio._source: BUILD_SPEC §7.4 — not from either source book

energy._source: standard Atwater factors; not stated in knowledge JSON

calorie_step_cap._source: owner decision 2026-10-04: cap each calorie adjustment at 100 kcal/day (~25 g carbs, ~0.2 lb/week: above the weekly-average noise floor) so changes stay attributable; larger gaps close over several check-ins

adherence._source: owner decision 2026-10-04: check-ins are optional; without a recent one, adjustments proceed at most medium confidence. The 14-day 'recent' window is a placeholder; daily 'Macros hit?' logs (owner request 2026-10-04) give adherence % = hit days / logged days over the window when the check-in has no adherence number. Window and minimum are placeholders

cardio_lever._source: owner decision 2026-10-04: cardio frequency then duration are tried before calories in a cut, coach-approved. All numbers are placeholders (not in either book)
